title: Creamy Roasted Feta & Veg Soup
description: Broccoli, cauliflower, carrot and onion roasted with feta and cottage cheese, then blended with stock and lemon.

source.name: Firsttakehadrian (Instagram)
source.note: Hype or Hoax, Episode 252, rated 9.15/10 (Worth the Hype). Original inspiration: @adamhoad_coaching.

confidence.note: Amounts and method from the creator's caption. Not yet cooked. Thyme, salt and pepper are to taste. The Thermomix blend is a swap for the source's blender, with no settings given.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Combine the feta ({{feta}}), cottage cheese ({{cottage}}), broccoli ({{broccoli}}), cauliflower ({{cauliflower}}), carrot ({{carrot}}), onion ({{onion}}), garlic ({{garlic}}) and spinach ({{spinach}}) in a baking dish and mix well.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Bake for 40 minutes until the vegetables are soft and lightly golden.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Transfer to a blender (or the Thermomix bowl), add the stock ({{stock}}) and lemon or lime juice ({{juice}}), and blend until completely smooth.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Season with thyme, salt and pepper to taste and serve warm.

notes.title: Capacity
notes.text: The roasted mixture plus 600ml stock may come close to the Thermomix's 2.2L limit. Blend in two batches if it looks full.
